cli.name: hook
cli.description: Bridge client hook events to the Makaio bus

subcommands.name: received
subcommands.description: Ingest a raw client hook event from stdin and emit it on the bus

args.name: eventName
args.description: Hook event name as reported by the native client

args.name: metadataJson
args.description: Optional JSON object for pass-through metadata (e.g. process PID)

subcommands.name: handle
subcommands.description: Ingest a client hook event and return a handler response via stdout/stderr/exitCode

args.name: eventName
args.description: Hook event name as reported by the native client

args.name: metadataJson
args.description: Optional JSON object for pass-through metadata (e.g. process PID)

args.name: timeout
args.description: Maximum wait time for a bus response in milliseconds

args.name: failClose
args.description: On error or timeout: exit non-zero instead of failing open
